A.role: retrospective completed-path coverage only; not a prospective signal or training sample selector for B
A.shape_source: SOXX close path normalized from first session open
A.distance_squared: 0.5 * mean(squared differences of 21 equally spaced cumulative log-return path points divided by own daily log-return sigma * sqrt(L)) + 0.5 * mean(squared differences of training-robust-scaled amplitude features)
A.soxl_role: leveraged-path comparison only, not in retrieval distance

B.role: as-of information-state retrieval; chosen 2026-08-31 anchor is retrospective, not a new clean OOS trial
B.distance_squared: equal average of within-block mean squared robust z differences for momentum, risk, trend and VIX blocks
B.actual_feature_support: 60-day return includes anchor-60 close (61 closes); use exact earliest dependency
B.query_forward20_status: incomplete in fixed 9/25 snapshot; only 18 realized sessions reported
B.boundary_purge: complete feature support through anchor+20 closing-price label must lie inside its historical cohort

scaling.scale: 1.4826*MAD; fallback IQR/1.349, then standard deviation, then 1 for constant features

description_threshold.reference: all disjoint support pairs from deterministic every-20th training-period candidate, with no outcome filtering
description_threshold.interpretation: descriptive geometry only; not a p value, predictive probability, or multiple-comparison-adjusted significance

event_deduplication.method: distance-ranked greedy non-overlapping full-support representatives; suppressed rows inherit the first overlapping representative cluster
event_deduplication.B_support: earliest feature price through anchor+20 closing price
event_deduplication.A_support: first session open through final session close
event_deduplication.independence_warning: nonoverlap count is not an effective IID sample size; prolonged regimes and common cross-asset shocks remain dependent

robustness: Report every fixed window variant and all cohort results, without choosing the best-looking one. No threshold or feature search.
future_training_boundary: A cannot select training data for a prospective B model. Any later training must nest selection/scaling inside time folds, purge matured labels, leave entire event and related assets together, and reserve new forward data.

price_source.reason: Pre-computation independent source audit found the main provider OHLC consistent; alternate contains an invalid OHLC bar. Do not mix levels from the two stores.
price_source.basis: Existing provider price returns, with no additional dividend cash; not asserted to be total returns or tradable net profits.
price_source.soxx_role: ETF proxy, not the underlying index itself; SOXL is not assumed to equal three times SOXX.
